method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across light that becomes life, the meanings of spirit and the gift of mediation, scripture, spiritual birth and the life beyond, receptivity, discernment and inward change, revelation and the renewal of the world, education, fellowship and the transformation of society, unity in practice, words, art and the courage to serve, steadfastness in particular lives and places, and gratitude, prayer and renewal at every moment. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit. The existing reading arc is retained.
